calls.title: Chris Harris and Scott Keller
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around identifying a suitable split testing tool that supports feature flags and server-side experiments, emphasizing usability for non-engineering teams. Chris Harris highlighted the importance of a tool that can effectively support both agency and client teams, drawing from past experiences with tools like Statsig and Chameleon. Scott Keller presented Growth Book as a strong candidate, emphasizing its engineering roots, open-source nature, and adaptability across tech stacks, which has contributed to its adoption by over 3,000 enterprise customers, including notable fast-growth companies. The conversation also touched on the platform's new visual editor, recent enhancements for improved user experience, and flexible pricing models aimed at accommodating various client needs. A demo session was scheduled to further evaluate Growth Book's capabilities.
calls.keywords: Split Testing, Growth Book, Experimentation Platform, Feature Flags, Pricing Models, Reseller Program
